raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Follow-up to #8926 per its rollout plan.

The `cpu-torch-latest-v1-multirank` suite has been green on repeated manual dispatch runs against master, so:

- `pull_request:` is added back to the `on:` block; diff-based selection (`collect-tests` + `ci/tests_fetcher.py`) keeps unrelated PRs at `mode=none`, so the ~1h suite only runs for PRs that touch the `tests/unit/v1` dependency graph.
- `merge_group:` is included so the merge queue can satisfy the check once it is registered as required in branch protection (a merge_group event has no PR base, so it runs the full v1 scope).
- The header comment now records the rollout state instead of the plan.

Required-check registration in branch protection is a repo-settings step for maintainers and is not part of this diff.

AI assistance: prepared with AI assistance (DeepSeek Harness agent) under human review; the submitter has read every changed line.

Signed-off-by: Ma, Guokai <guokai.ma@intel.com>

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle subsets with no applicable multi-rank tests**

For a PR whose selected subset contains no retained multi-rank item—for example, a direct edit to `tests/unit/v1/zero/test_overlap_comm_record_stream.py`, whose tests are not `DistributedTest`s—the selector returns `subset` and starts this job, but `DS_MULTIRANK_ONLY` at line 292 makes `tests/conftest.py:77-93` deselect every item and pytest exits 5 for no tests. Manual dispatch always selects the full scope, so it does not exercise this case, and the new required check will block otherwise valid PRs; detect an empty applicable subset before invoking pytest or handle that no-test outcome explicitly.

When a PR's target branch has advanced, `github.event.pull_request.base.sha` used at line 96 can be days older than the base in the checked-out merge commit, so the selector's merge-base diff includes intervening master changes and may choose `mode=all` for an unrelated PR (for example after a `ci/**` or core-runtime change), spending the roughly one-hour suite this trigger is intended to avoid. The repository documents this payload behavior at `.github/workflows/TEST_SELECTION.md:87-93`; use the merge commit's exact first parent as `check-paths.yml` does.

files.patch:
@@ -13,10 +13,9 @@ name: cpu-torch-latest-v1-multirank
 # DS_MULTIRANK_ONLY drops single-rank tests, so a run spends its time on
 # world_size 2-4 CPU tests.
 #
-# Trigger rollout: manual dispatch only for now. Starting as a required
-# pull_request check would put an unvalidated ~1h suite in front of every PR;
-# once this run is green across a few real PRs, add `pull_request:` back to the
-# `on:` block and register the check with branch protection.
+# Trigger rollout: manual dispatch validated the suite on master, so it now
+# also runs on pull requests and in the merge queue; register the unit-tests
+# check with branch protection to make it required.
 
 on:
   workflow_dispatch:
@@ -49,6 +48,9 @@ on:
         required: false
         default: 'main'
         type: string
+  pull_request:
+  merge_group:
+    branches: [ master ]
 
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
